question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.id_bioguide
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(CAST(term_start AS DATE)) AS first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE id_bioguide IN (SELECT id_bioguide FROM male_la_legislators)
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
dec31_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(date AS DATE) AS dec31
    FROM legislation_date_dim
    WHERE day_of_month = 31 AND month_name = 'December'
),
legislator_dec31 AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        ft.first_term_start,
        d.dec31
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN first_terms ft ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
    JOIN dec31_dates d ON d.dec31 >= CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) AND d.dec31 <= CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE)
    WHERE lt.id_bioguide IN (SELECT id_bioguide FROM male_la_legislators)
),
years_elapsed AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        first_term_start,
        dec31,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dec31)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_term_start)::INTEGER AS years_elapsed
    FROM legislator_dec31
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS distinct_legislators
FROM years_elapsed
WHERE years_elapsed > 30 AND years_elapsed < 50
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed;
